facts.section: How does Niacinamide work on your face?
facts.text: When applied topically, Niacinamide works on our skin by getting converted to NADH and NADPH; these compounds provide energy to the cells tackling free radicals and boosting protein synthesis, hence providing a protective skin barrier. This conversion also reduces the production of sebum, aiding in the prevention of acne and blemishes.

facts.section: Does Niacinamide help in the lightening or brightening of the skin?
facts.text: Scientific studies have proven its property to inhibit melanin production & distribution, which helps treat hyperpigmentation and lightens dark spots hence enhancing skin tone. Still, there are no clinical studies of it providing a lighter skin tone when used individually.

facts.section: Does Niacinamide help in the lightening or brightening of the skin?
facts.text: Along with Niacinamide, this serum contains Bifida Ferment Lysate which is known to brighten skin tone.

facts.section: What is the right age to start using Niacinamide serum?
facts.text: Niacinamide is safe to use at any age, but you will need it after 18 -20 years when the body's natural ability to form a skin barrier starts degrading. It can also be used in your teenage to combat acne marks caused by your teen acne.
